overview_description.description:
DigitalOcean is a cloud computing platform that deploys, manages, and scales applications of any size. Its infrastructure and platform-as-a-service solutions provide a no DevOps required experience, allowing developers to focus their energy on creating innovative software. By combining the power of simplicity, love for the developer community, an obsession for customer service, and the advantages of open source, DigitalOcean brings software development within the technical and economic reach of anyone around the world.

DigitialOcean was formed in 2012 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

about_short_description.short_description: DigitalOcean provides a cloud platform to deploy, manage, and scale applications of any size.

product.name: Inference Engine
product.description: An API-driven platform for running AI models through serverless, dedicated, or batch inference. It supports hosted models and bring-your-own models through a unified endpoint.

product.name: Droplets
product.description: Scalable virtual machines for hosting applications, websites, databases, development environments, and AI workloads. Droplets are available with CPU and GPU configurations.

product.name: Managed Kubernetes
product.description: A managed Kubernetes service for deploying and operating containerized applications without managing the Kubernetes control plane. It supports scalable application clusters and cloud-native workloads.

product.name: App Platform
product.description: A managed application platform that builds, deploys, and runs applications from source code or container images. It provides application hosting without requiring direct server management.

product.name: Managed Databases
product.description: A managed database service supporting popular database engines with automated infrastructure operations. It provides hosted database resources for application data and persistent workloads.

product.name: GPU Droplets
product.description: GPU-equipped cloud virtual machines for model training, fine-tuning, inference, rendering, and other accelerated workloads. They provide on-demand access to supported NVIDIA and AMD GPU resources.
